question: Do frozen GDI predictions follow actual Toronto TUG and POMA-Gait differences?
authorization: User selected frozen-model association first; no TUG/POMA fitting or recalibration.
primary: Same six people and exactly the same native 124-frame BODY25 tracks, adapted separately by each original model's preprocessing.
exclusions: Existing visual tracking exclusions 7/11 retained. People 3/10/13/14 fail unchanged H36M confidence preservation; no confidence clipping, replacement windows, or outcome-based exclusions.
supplements: All existing H36M inputs: 12 people/59 segments. Original 12-feature CNN inputs: 10 people/10 segments. Separate summaries, never a common-input model ranking.
model_eligibility_audit: Original single-window GPU CNN omitted before association calculation: original verification explicitly says checkpoints_downloaded=false. Its predictions are not substituted for a checkpoint. Remaining 15 predictors have local checkpoints.
source_folds: All five fixed source fold models. Average segments within person, then source folds. Five source models are not five independent external samples.
primary_output: Mean of left/right GDI. Left and right outputs retained descriptively, never selected by target correlation.
metrics: Person-level Spearman rho (primary), Pearson r (descriptive), two-sided permutation p, Holm adjustment across all model-target tests within each cohort, percentile person-bootstrap 95% interval, leave-one-person-out rho range, rho after removing the single 25-second TUG person. No clinical success threshold or conversion to target units.
randomization: seed 20261031, bootstrap 10000 person resamples; primary all 720 label permutations; supplementary 9999 Monte Carlo permutations with plus-one p correction. Degenerate bootstrap/LOO samples are counted and excluded from intervals, not set to zero.
interpretation: Exploratory source-cohort transfer; Toronto already used for TUG development, not an untouched external final evaluation. Tiny person count, narrow POMA range, frontal-vs-side view and uncertain training/source time-axis agreement restrict interpretation.
storage: Only small derived arrays, predictions, figures, code and audit records in this C study directory. Reuse existing D video/pose/model files read-only. No downloads, new model copies or training.
verification: Exact original clinical labels, source hashes before/after, original preprocessing and source-prediction replays, independent participant aggregation/statistic recomputation, no fitting methods in new inference path. Numerical tolerances: linear/RF 1e-8, CNN 1e-4 GDI, cached encoder features 1e-5 relative and 2e-6 absolute.
